description: Generative AI will lead to productivity improvements, but the overall TFP and GDP effects within the next 10 years will be modest.

instances.assertion: Generative AI will lead to productivity improvements, but the overall TFP and GDP effects within the next 10 years will be modest.
AI productivity gains over the next 10 years are estimated to be modest, with TFP growth projected to be less than 0.53%.
Generative AI is predicted to increase total factor productivity (TFP) by no more than 0.66% over a 10-year period.
